releaseNotes:
Paid receipts no longer read UNPAID.

If your book has receipts showing UNPAID although the money was taken and no older debt could have taken it, this version repairs them the first time it starts. It takes a backup before it changes anything, records what it did, and can be undone. It only corrects a receipt's STATUS - no amount is changed, and no receipt is added or removed.

A receipt whose money genuinely paid an older debt is left exactly as it is.
